deliverables: Performance optimization targeting 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile plus reduced L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.
Operational excellence work including operator runbooks, simpler node configuration, observability and logging, and an improved TUI.
Ecosystem support including features requested by production users and pipeline integrators, Hydra Alliance facilitation, hackathons, and developer relations.
Maintenance and developer experience work including CI, tooling, and technical debt reduction.
request.what: Fund Hydra v2 production hardening and performance improvements through four workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and maintenance/developer experience.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as a Layer 2 state channel for Cardano that settles final results on Cardano L1 while enabling instant or sub-second transactions at near-zero cost among participants.
The proposal states that Hydra is the only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 on Cardano.
The proposal says Hydra has powered or is used by Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposer claims Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, about $0.17 per transaction, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, making some high-performance applications uncompetitive or infeasible on L1.
The proposal claims the funded performance workstream will deliver 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduce L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.
The proposer claims Hydra applications can increase L1 settlement usage and protocol revenue through head opening, fund movement, closure transactions, and optionally routed internal head fees.
The proposal states the ₳5,100,781 ask will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.

The proposal claims Hydra aligns with treasury KPIs for TVL, monthly active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, and annual protocol revenue, as well as Pillars 1, 2, 4, and 5.
The proposal claims delayed funding could cause current or prospective Hydra users to migrate to competing chains and make attracting new builders harder.

summary: The proposal requests ₳5,100,781 for milestone-gated Hydra v2 hardening across performance, operations, ecosystem support, and developer experience, but the anchor text mostly asserts benefits, adoption, economic impact, and delivery expectations without presenting a detailed budget, feasibility analysis, alternatives analysis, failure-mode analysis, or quantified community impact.
